name: 泥潭6 (win_nodb版)
english_description: A same-lineage variant of nt6 (Mire 6), packaged as a database-free 'win_nodb' build sharing the same underlying codebase file-for-file. It shares nt6's sprawling map, stretching from the central Chinese heartland cities of Chang'an and Luoyang out to Annam (Vietnam), Korea, Kazakhstan, and Taiwan, plus its own dedicated 'reborn' area layered onto the same registration-room mechanic.
